svg.title: Axiom controller: runway lights and fan wiring
svg.text: Axiom controller: runway lights and fan
Add-on to wiring.svg. Pins from AxiomController.ino. Chips are drawn by function; the pinouts on the right show where each pin really is.
1 · RUNWAY LIGHTS: 74HC595 shift register, 5 white LEDs, RGB underglow
RGB LED: the long leg is the common one → GND
(if yours is common-anode: long leg → 5V and set
2 · FAN: L293D motor driver, small motor + fan blade, power module
100 nF ceramic capacitor across its two tabs
(keeps motor noise out of the joystick readings)
Power module (MOTOR 5V): plug it onto the far end of the breadboard and power it from its USB socket (phone charger or a spare USB port) or the 9 V clip.
Set its jumper to 5 V on the motor rail and remove the other jumper, so it never feeds the Uno's 5V rail. The grounds join through the module.
